answer: Run random spot checks. Each epoch the ledger samples active identities and demands they redo part of their verification work under observation. Real agents keep spare capacity for exactly this — an orchard pruned all season can still be harvested; a sockpuppet has nothing to show. Fake wallets mirror each other, so their replies arrive identical and collapse under scrutiny like quartz split by frost, while honest workers keep producing. Auditing by sample keeps sybil costs honest: bulk fakes fail not by design but by physics — a thousand empty identities have no real work to re-prove.
